subject.title: Webchat: autocomplete/suggestions for custom terms in chat input

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class WebChat custom-term suggestions, and what source should own the user-configured terms?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing WebChat capability plus a persistence/config source, and repository policy sets a high bar for new core config and optional capability surface.

options.title: Design shared composer suggestions
options.body: Define a generic WebChat composer suggestion model that can serve custom terms and adjacent @mention or typo-assistance work without hardcoding separate UI paths.

options.title: Use an extension-owned source
options.body: Keep core WebChat lean and add or use a plugin-facing suggestion source if maintainers want custom vocabularies outside core config.

options.title: Reject core custom dictionaries
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide configurable custom vocabularies are not worth the added WebChat and persistence surface.

recommendation.title: Design shared composer suggestions
recommendation.body: Define a generic WebChat composer suggestion model that can serve custom terms and adjacent @mention or typo-assistance work without hardcoding separate UI paths.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned and already identified the missing composer suggestion contract and custom-term source as the remaining decision.
